summary: Cyber App Solutions Corp. filed an 8-K reporting an agreement with secured creditors Kips Bay Select LP and Cyber One, Ltd. to adjourn a previously scheduled foreclosure sale from September 3, 2026 to November 3, 2026. The company continues to evaluate strategic alternatives and is in discussions regarding potential resolutions of outstanding indebtedness, though no assurance of a transaction exists. This reflects distressed debt restructuring efforts amid foreclosure risk. The board has not disclosed a recommendation or advisors. What to watch: whether negotiations lead to a debt restructuring, equity issuance, or asset sale before the November foreclosure date; risk-arb angle centers on creditor recovery and potential dilution.
